name: orkestr Sandboxes

modes.label: Pay-as-you-go sandbox (metered on actual use)
modes.note: orkestr.eu/pricing (Sandboxes tab, JS bundle, 2026-09-28): vCPU EUR 0.045/hour, RAM EUR 0.015/GiB-hour, storage EUR 0.10/GB-month; sizes small 1 vCPU/1 GB, medium 2 vCPU/4 GB, large 4 vCPU/8 GB ('cost shown at full utilization'). Metered 'per second, on actual usage - real on-CPU time and working-set RAM, not the provisioned size'. Converted at 1.1378 USD/EUR (ECB 2026-09-28). Prices in EUR, VAT applied where required.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: No card: 'EUR 5 credit, then it stops', 'Small only, 3 concurrent', '30-min sessions'. Trial only.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.note: Card on file: 'EUR 25 credit, then metered', all sizes, concurrency 'High' (number not published), sessions 'Up to 24 h', 10 snapshots, own spend cap.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Dedicated EU nodes, custom limits + SLA, audit logs, SSO. Custom price.

caveats: Rates come from the Sandboxes tab of orkestr.eu/pricing (rendered from the site's JS bundle); the orkestr.eu/sandboxes page still says 'Published rates land once we have metered real workloads'. Treat as a published but early (beta) rate card. Billed on actual on-CPU time and working-set RAM, so idle sandboxes cost almost nothing. First 10 GB of held storage (snapshots + templates) free, then EUR 0.10/GB-month. Egress price unpublished; full egress needs a paid verified account.
Default network off; full egress needs paid verified account.
150–300 ms cold-start claims vary by page/template; no benchmark recorded.
Worked example assumes resources are released between active windows unless a retained-instance scenario is explicitly discussed.
VAT basis: Unknown: reviewed pricing source does not explicitly establish VAT/tax inclusion.
Residency: Provider claims code, memory, snapshots and environment remain EU; Falkenstein DE, Helsinki FI, Roubaix FR; DPA available. Not independently audited.

fleet.verification: Verified email earns starter credit, no card; card unlocks all sandbox sizes and paid metering.
fleet.notes: Sandbox PAYG is independent of Platform subscription. Platform PR-preview concurrent deployments (1/5) are not Sandbox runtime quotas. No numeric new-account sandbox count or increase path found.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages
